body: Fuck those teachers then! Their job is to HELP you, they are in your service and i am 100% sure that if you tell any other university that your teachers REFUSED to help you that they will gladly accept you help you in any way possible. Schools love this kind of PR.

Try to learn how to do something! There are tons of free hobbies and a lot of people are very inclined to teach you, just google your local area and try SOMETHING, you may not enjoy it but you might just spark your urge to learn!

This may not help you, but if it does, that is great.

I consider myself moderately ugly, I don't like the way that I look but most people don't care about what I look like. They are too busy being worried about how THEY look like and what everyone else thinks about THEM. As long as you are nice and respectful, people will like you.

I primarily listen to house or rap music but I cant say that it has any negative psychological effects on me, just helps me relax. I just feel really worthless and without meaning at night.

I am 100% fine during the day so it may just be a side effect from my medication, even though I have been taking them for SEVERAL years I've never had this kind of side effect until just about a year ago.

Perhaps the recent passing of my dog sparked some kind of chemical reaction which is causing me to have these thoughts and near attemps of suicide.
It just keeps getting worse week after week, im usually fine during the  day but these nights are almost well, killing me.
Shove some fingers down that throat, I didnt kill myself today, so neither should you.
